title: saját élet: A Life of Her Own

sections.title: Two useful new words
sections.content: saját ("own") and élet ("life") combine as saját élet — "a life of one's own". Add a possessive suffix the way you already do everywhere else: saját életem ("my own life").

items.spanish: Most már saját életem van itt, nem csak Károlyé.
items.english: Now I have a life of my own here, not just Károly's.

items.spanish: Vannak saját barátaim, akik nem csak Károly barátai.
items.english: I have friends of my own, who aren't just Károly's friends.

sections.content: Károlyé ("Károly's [one]") uses the -é possessive pronoun ending — the same job enyém does for "mine" back in A1, just for a name instead of "I".
